entities.name: Eleni
entities.description: An elf of the Knotvine tribe from Naya who, stranded in Jund after the Conflux, became a tattooed berserker.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Paradise jungle Shard of Alara, Eleni's homeland.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Harsh volcanic Shard where Eleni was stranded.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event after which Eleni was stranded in Jund.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Entity honored by an elvish monument whose relic Eleni used.

entities.name: Undead wurm
entities.description: Creature Eleni destroyed with the relic of Progenitus.

entities.name: Human warrior clan
entities.description: Jund warrior clan Eleni integrated into.

events.summary: After the Conflux, Eleni is stranded in the volcanic wilds of Jund far from her homeland.
events.quote: After the Conflux , Eleni was stranded in the dangerous volcanic wilds of Jund

events.summary: Eleni uses the relic of Progenitus to end an undead wurm's ability to resist death, so it withers to dust.
events.quote: using the relic of Progenitus to end the wurm's supernatural ability to resist death

events.summary: Eleni adapts to Jund, becoming a respected figure among the human warrior clan and negotiating with their leader.
events.quote: She became a respected figure among the human warrior clan, negotiating with their leader

relations.quote: Eleni was originally from the Knotvine tribe of Naya .
adapt and integrate into the warrior culture of Jund
